sources.label: Current issuer deployment roster and control architecture

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Etherlink block 58095676 (2026-11-15T22:48:35Z), the sole issuer-listed EURSM deployment points to implementation 0x31f9c14c777e210b33ca35e875c7d1ee6dbeefb4. Its verified addToBlacklist function targets arbitrary addresses and _update rejects transfers from or to listed holders. hasRole(BLACKLIST_ROLE, 0x1bb0b2666edd827f74b558136fdbe69e4ecec5fd) is true; the same address is defaultAdmin and returns empty runtime bytecode. This establishes a current holder-targeted control, without implying that a freeze has occurred.
